Ultra-realistic underwater portrait, 21-year-old Chinese woman playing with a mythical white dragon. Her wavy hair adorned with glowing jellyfish ornaments, wearing flowing translucent white silk that dances in the currents. The pearl-scaled Chinese dragon coils gracefully around her, its silver whiskers trailing, golden eyes glowing. Sunbeams pierce through, illuminating jade rock formations and golden koi fish. Hyper-detailed, magical realism, Chinese mythology style, 8K resolution, cinematic lighting.
